content.short: Nextme enables a Web3 DID social gateway and space protocol for a decentralized social portal.
content.description: Nextme seeks to be the most beautiful social portal and a decentralized UGC hub for Web3. It offers personalized templates, a streamlined, one-stop delivery flow, and instant sharing of your Web3 social profile within the community square. Users can connect, create, interact, transact, and profit together. Social data rights belong to all holders, and income from platform traffic ads and profile views is returned to active participants through a decentralized agreement settlement model.
content.meta: Nextme builds a Web3 DID social gateway and space protocol for decentralized social portal. Discover Nextme and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
